user_query:
Please provide the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) energy of this molecule.

Input: [C][C][C][O][C][C][C][=Branch1][C][=O][C][Ring1][Branch1]

Please analyze this chemical task and provide a clear, precise answer.

problem_meta.instruction: Please provide the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) energy of this molecule.
problem_meta.agent_answer:
The input is valid **SELFIES** notation and decodes to:

`CCCOC1CC(=O)C1`

The reported lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy is:

\[
\boxed{\text{LUMO} = -0.0198\ \text{Ha}}
\]

This value is given in **Hartree (Ha)**, as requested. Note that the database label appears to contain a ring-size naming discrepancy; the decoded connectivity corresponds to a propoxy-substituted cyclobutanone.
